snippet.title: Hong Kong 2097 Announcement Trailer - Happy Soft + Kanipro
snippet.description: Hong Kong 2097 is the OFFICIAL sequel to Hong Kong 97, widely known as the worst game ever made. We've teamed up with Happy Soft (aka Kowloon Kurosawa) to bring immorality back to gaming. Shoot your way through five worlds with multiple substages and bosses to wipe out the Amurikkkans and build a utopia. Chin is ALIVE!!!
